description: This file defines the ConceptAnswer entity class within the OpenMRS healthcare application. It models an answer option associated with a Concept question, including references to answer concepts, drugs, creator information, and sorting weight. It includes annotations for ORM mapping, auditing, and serialization, and provides methods for accessing and modifying its fields, as well as comparison logic based on sorting weight.

classes.name: ConceptAnswer
classes.description: Entity class representing an answer to a Concept question, including references to answer concept, answer drug, creator, creation date, and sort weight, with persistence and comparison capabilities.

methods.name: getAnswerConcept
methods.description: Returns the Concept representing the answer to the question.

methods.name: setAnswerConcept
methods.description: Sets the Concept representing the answer to the question.

methods.name: getAnswerDrug
methods.description: Returns the Drug answer associated with the concept answer, if any.

methods.name: setAnswerDrug
methods.description: Sets the Drug answer associated with the concept answer.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the question Concept associated with this answer.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the question Concept for this answer.

methods.name: getConceptAnswerId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this ConceptAnswer.

methods.name: setConceptAnswerId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this ConceptAnswer.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the User who created this ConceptAnswer.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator User for this ConceptAnswer.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the date when this ConceptAnswer was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date of this ConceptAnswer.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier (same as getConceptAnswerId), conforming to OpenMRS object interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this ConceptAnswer.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns null; Placeholder for possible auditing extension.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns null; Placeholder for possible auditing extension.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Empty method; placeholder for auditing.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Empty method; placeholder for auditing.

methods.name: getSortWeight
methods.description: Returns the sort weight used for ordering ConceptAnswers.

methods.name: setSortWeight
methods.description: Sets the sort weight to influence ordering of ConceptAnswers.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ConceptAnswer with another based on sort weight; used for ordering.
